english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on lacking direction or a clear path rather than lacking a specific goal.

examples.english: After graduation, I still haven’t figured out which path to take, so I feel aimless.
examples.traditional: 畢業之後我仲未諗到行邊條路，覺得自己冇方向。
